quests.title: Custom Gift Envelope No. 1

dialogue.t: Huh, this doesn't seem right, either... These gift envelopes are really hard to make.

dialogue.sit: Mika, are you making gift envelopes?

dialogue.t: {NICKNAME}! What a coincidence! I wasn't expecting to see you here.

dialogue.sit: Are you here to celebrate Lantern Rite?

dialogue.t: Oh, no, no. I came to deliver a letter, and it just so happened to be during Lantern Rite.
Klee said she really wanted a Lantern Rite gift envelope, so I thought about buying one to take back.
Imagine my surprise when I found out you have to make them yourself...
I spent a long time trying to make one, but it still feels "off" for some reason. I can't tell where I went wrong...
{NICKNAME}, you know more about Liyue customs than me... Could you give me some advice on how to improve it?

dialogue.sit: Hmm, let me think about it for a second...

dialogue.t: {NICKNAME}, you know more about Liyue customs than me... Could you give me some advice on how to improve it?

dialogue.sit: Hmm, let me think about it for a second...

dialogue.t: Whoa, it's beautiful! So well made, and you did it so fast... You're amazing, {NICKNAME}!
...Oh no! I should really get going! I need to report back to the Knights!
Thanks for the help, {NICKNAME}! I'm sure Klee will love the envelope.

quests.description: Someone seems interested in creating a Gift Envelope…
